verdict.rationale: Ramp documents Funds as budgets with enforced restrictions: amount, interval, allowed merchants, categories and countries. Its spend controls layer applies budgets, templates and approval workflows across cards, reimbursements and bills, enforcing limits before spend happens. Cards and permissions can be set for individual teams, approvals route by amount, team role or category, and spend requests are recommended against budgets. Missing for 10: explicit project-level budget allocation, team/department budget rollups beyond per-card or per-fund limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works as claimed.
